name: gemma4-locbench-v1
description: Localization probe set for context-selection methods on the Gemma 4 Developer Agent public training tasks. Score a context selector by the fraction of gold_files (and gold_hunk_symbols) covered within a fixed character budget; verification via pytest on verification_test_files after applying the candidate patch.
